A2 · Week 16 · Lesson 2 · Final practical assessment

Communication mission

    Your mission

    Mariam needs to speak to Hana or Sara about a small problem. You will do one short task in your own words, then check it and make it better.

    • Choose a task and some fictional details.
    • Speak or write your answer.
    • Answer one follow-up.
    • Check your answer and try again.

    This is private practice. Nothing is sent or booked.

    A worked example Example

    Mariam changes an appointment. This is an example, not a real conversation. Your own words are fine.

    MariamHello, I'm calling about my appointment.
    SaraWhat would you like to change?
    MariamCould I change my appointment? I can't attend on Thursday.
    SaraFriday at two is free. Is that OK?
    MariamYes, thank you. Could you confirm it, please?

    Choose your task

    Choose one task.

      Your task card


        You need to

        • Say why you are calling.
        • Give one useful detail.
        • Answer the follow-up.
        • End with a clear next step.
        Useful phrases (optional)
        • I'm calling about...
        • Could you explain...?
        • I've been here since...
